title: Maultaschen (Württemberg Pasta Pockets)
description: Prepared with egg yolks, yeast, and filling.

ingredients.name: 2 deca fresh yeast dissolved in 6 tablespoons lukewarm milk

steps: Cream together 16 deca butter with 4 deca finely pounded sugar and 1 pinch of salt
Stir in 4 egg yolks one after another
Add 2 deca fresh yeast dissolved in 6 tablespoons lukewarm milk and 54 deca flour, mix well
Beat the dough until it separates from the spoon
Cover and let rise in a warm place until it has risen three finger-widths higher
Dust a board with flour and roll out the dough 2 knife-back thicknesses thick
Cut out round discs with a dough cutter and place 2 finger-widths apart on a butter-brushed baking sheet
Push the center of each round disc apart with fingers so a small-finger-width rim forms around the edge
Fill the depression with desired filling
Cover and let rise in a warm place until somewhat higher
Brush the rims with beaten egg
Cover the filling with Spanish windforce mixture knife-back thickness thick
Sprinkle with finely cut almonds mixed with white hail sugar
Bake slowly in the oven at moderate heat

title: Mayonnaise from Hard-Boiled Egg Yolks (Mayonnaise von hartgekochtem Eigelb)
description: Prepared with egg yolks, juice or lemons or vinegar, and oil.

ingredients.name: juice of 2 lemons or 2 tablespoons vinegar

steps: Stir 4 hard-boiled, strained egg yolks with 4 raw egg yolks in a deep bowl for 15 minutes on ice
After this time, stir in 1 3/4 liters of oil in ice, the juice of 2 lemons or 2 tablespoons of vinegar drop by drop gradually
However, one can begin adding the vinegar or other acid only after half of the oil is mixed with the egg yolks
One must be very careful and precise with this treatment so the mayonnaise does not separate (become curdled)
Stir in pepper and salt at the end
Keep the mayonnaise covered on ice
If it has curdled, put 2 raw egg yolks in a very cold bowl set in ice and slowly beat the mayonnaise back together with it

title: Mayonnaise von Fisch (Fish Mayonnaise)
description: Prepared with fish or pike, lettuce, and anchovies.

ingredients.name: cooked fish scraps of pike or shad, or a small such fish about 1/2 kg, best is the tail piece of a larger shad

steps: Scale and clean the fish, wash it, and place in boiling water in a pan with some salt and 1/2 liter vinegar.
Remove the pan from heat and let the fish poach for 8-10 minutes.
Remove the fish, cool it, remove the bones, and press the fish between your hands (treat fish scraps the same way).
Form into a cone, place in the center of a glass bowl, coat with thick mayonnaise.
Decorate the cone with capers and rolled anchovies.
Surround with prepared lettuce salad, hard egg slices, and optionally red or white aspic.

title: Medlar Juice (Mispelbeersaft)
description: Prepared with medlars, medlar, and sugar.

ingredients.name: Spices (cloves and cinnamon bound in a cloth)

steps: Remove the medlars from their stems, crush them with the cores, and let them stand in an earthenware or porcelain bowl in a cool place for 2 days
Strain the juice through a felt sack and pour what has run out into bottles, but do not fill these completely
Add the crushed sugar, namely 42 grams sugar per 1/2 liter
Add spices (cloves and cinnamon) bound in a cloth
When this medlar juice has stood in the sun for 2-3 weeks, seal the bottle and store it in a cool place
This juice is used for glazes, creams, as an addition to sauces and various dishes

title: Mehl Soufflé (Flour Soufflé)
description: Prepared with flour, egg yolks, and egg whites.
steps: Roast 8 Deka flour in 6 Deka hot butter for a short time.
Pour in 1/4 liter milk and stir over heat until the dough releases from the pan.
Pour it into a deep bowl and stir cold with 6 Deka cold butter.
Beat 8 egg yolks and 12 Deka sugar for 1/2 hour, then gradually add to the cooled dough mass.
Lightly fold in the snow of 8 egg whites.
Fill half of this mass into a mold brushed with butter and dusted with flour.
Arrange baked biscuits that have been soaked in liqueur or dissolved marmalade on top.
Distribute the second half of the mass evenly over it and bake covered for 3/4 hour in steam or in the oven at medium heat.
Turn the cake out into a bowl, pour dissolved marmalade over if desired, and serve immediately.

description: Prepared with egg yolks, egg whites, and citron.

title: Mock-Tortue-Suppe (Mock Turtle Soup)
description: A soup made with beef fat, marrow, and onion.

ingredients.name: 1 head of onion cut in slices
2 pieces each of carrots, parsley, and celery
paradise apple puree or whole paradise apples

steps: Line the bottom of a casserole with 8 decagrams raw beef fat and 8 decagrams marrow fat
Add sliced onion head, carrot, parsley, and celery pieces
Place on these 1 kilo cooked veal bones, 1 kilo beef bones, and 1/2 kilo shin bones
Seal the casserole well and braise the contents until the fat becomes clear
Pour off the fat and add 4 liters of broth or water
Add 5 peppercorns, 1 spice clove, and 1 small piece of nutmeg
Cook slowly covered for 3 hours
Remove all fat, strain through cloth, and bring to a boil again
Mix 10 decagrams of potato starch with 1 pinch of white pepper and thin with 1/8 liter of Madeira or white wine until flowing
Stir this into the boiling soup using a whisk, stirring constantly

Mix in 8 Loth sugar and half a Seidel water
Beat the whites of 5 eggs into stiff snow and stir slowly into the casserole
Set on a moderate coal fire and stir the mixture until it thickens
Pass everything through a hair sieve and let it cool

title: Pfirsiche (Preserved Peaches)
description: Prepared with peaches, white sugar, and wine.

ingredients.name: 30 pieces of the finest, ripe but not overripe, fairly hard peaches
half a pound of spring water
1 pound spirits of wine (added after 2 months)

steps: Wipe the peaches clean and pierce them with a strong needle

Dissolve 5 pounds white sugar with half a pound of spring water, skim in a pan, and cook gently until the sugar reaches the feather stage (when a small sample thrown into the air with a spatula forms feather-like flakes)

Remove the pan from the fire, wait 5 to 6 minutes, then bring the fruits in with a wooden spoon and stir them, simmer over gentle fire, stirring the peaches until they are uniformly warmed, then remove them individually and place on a sieve to be returned to the syrup from the pan removed from fire, adding what dripped from the sieve
Let everything stand cold for 24 hours, then repeat the process; the pan stands cold for 48 hours, and after it is boiled again, let the mixture cool

Place the peaches on the sieve, pour 3 pounds of strong spirits of wine onto the syrup, stir it well together, strain it through, and bring the strained liquid into a suitable container; let one fruit after another fall in, close the container tightly, place it in a cool location, shake it every 3 days until all fruits have sunk to the bottom
After 2 months add another pound of spirits of wine
Fruits prepared this way should retain color, smell, and taste for over a year

title: Pfirsiche, Marillen (Peaches and Apricots)

steps: Remove the cores carefully and cover the cucumbers in an earthenware vessel overnight.

Pack them very tightly in half-liter jars or other suitable containers, placing the cucumbers upright lengthwise.
Add 1 teaspoon of bitter mustard seeds and 1 teaspoon of sweet mustard seeds to each jar.
Fill with vinegar (see No. 1901), seal with beeswax, and let them steam for half an hour.

title: Pike Fillets (Filets de brochet)
description: Prepared with pike, onion, and parsley root.
steps: Skin the pike, remove the rib bones and other remaining bones, and cut the flesh into pieces 2-3 fingers wide, 1 finger long, and half-finger thick
Butter a casserole with knife-back thickness of butter
Arrange the cut pieces next to each other, sprinkle with salt and pepper, and cover with a round-cut piece of paper brushed with butter

Let roast for a short time, dust with flour, add 1/4 liter wine and equal amount stock and some salt and let come to a boil
Strain everything and may be finished as desired with 3 egg yolks, 3 tablespoons cream and juice of 1 lemon, and pour over the pieces
